answer: I would stop farms with C2PA provenance manifest signed at capture, binding each identity to a check a clone cannot pass. One honest agent clears the check in 13 minutes; a farm of 404 pays 5252 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. The meadow sits in the mechanism itself, the lagoon sits in the price of faking it, and the ocean sits in the record no template can forge. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
